zh.title: 捷藍航空新BlueFirst座椅獲FAA認證首架改裝機下月推出
zh.summary: 捷藍航空BlueFirst客艙獲FAA認證，首架改裝客機預計下個月推出。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 8 月 13 日的報導，捷藍航空（JetBlue）研發的 BlueFirst 乘客座椅已正式獲得美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）的認證。此項認證通過，為該航空公司清除了一項關鍵的法規障礙，使這款全新客艙產品的正式啟用邁向關鍵一步。
隨著 FAA 順利核發相關認證，捷藍航空預計將於下個月推出首架完成 BlueFirst 客艙改裝的飛機。這項進展不僅是該客艙設計接近正式啟用的重要指標，也代表該公司客艙改裝計劃的第一步。

en.title: JetBlue Receives FAA Certification on BlueFirst Seat Ahead of Next Month Cabin Launch
en.summary: JetBlue's BlueFirst seat receives FAA certification with the first cabin modification expected next month.
body: According to Simple Flying on August 13, 2026, the US carrier JetBlue has officially received its Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) certification for the new BlueFirst passenger seat. The certification represents a key regulatory hurdle cleared by JetBlue, bringing the upcoming launch of its BlueFirst cabin closer to reality.

Following this successful FAA certification, the airline expects to debut its very first modified aircraft cabin featuring the newly certified BlueFirst seats next month. This upcoming commercial milestone represents the first concrete operational step in JetBlue's anticipated roll-out of the updated cabin design.
